summary.value: Instead of dealing damage on a successful unarmed attack, make an opposed MIG+DEX vs MIG+MIG check.

system.description: Instead of dealing damage on a successful unarmed attack, make an opposed MIG+DEX vs MIG+MIG check. On success, set up the target: your next attack against them this scene deals × (1 + SL ÷ 3, rounded down) damage.
